Transform a SPICE parse tree into a Netlist model.

Architecture: - Bottom-up: subcircuit bodies resolve before enclosing scope. - Dict-based lookups everywhere for O(n) overall complexity. - Per-subcircuit NetMap built in single pass over instances. - Stateful: _all_subckts accumulates all resolved subcircuit Circuits so later subcircuits can resolve X-instance port names from earlier ones.

Source code in src/kfnetlist/morphnet/netlist/spice/transformer.py 
class SpiceTransformer(Transformer[Token, Netlist]):
    """Transform a SPICE parse tree into a Netlist model.

    Architecture:
    - Bottom-up: subcircuit bodies resolve before enclosing scope.
    - Dict-based lookups everywhere for O(n) overall complexity.
    - Per-subcircuit NetMap built in single pass over instances.
    - Stateful: _all_subckts accumulates all resolved subcircuit Circuits
      so later subcircuits can resolve X-instance port names from earlier ones.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.all_subckts: dict[str, Circuit] = {}

    # ── Leaf transformers ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    def token_number(self, items: list[Token]) -> Token:
        return items[0]

    def token_ident(self, items: list[Token]) -> Token:
        return items[0]

    def pvalue_number(self, items: list[Token]) -> ParameterValue:
        return parse_parameter_number(str(items[0]))

    def pvalue_ident(self, items: list[Token]) -> ParameterValue:
        return ParameterValue()

    def pvalue_string(self, items: list[Token]) -> ParameterValue:
        return ParameterValue()

    def param_assign(self, items: list[Any]) -> tuple[str, ParameterValue]:
        name = str(items[0])
        value = items[1]
        if not isinstance(value, ParameterValue):
            value = ParameterValue()
        return (name, value)

    # ── Instance statement ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    def instance_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> InstanceData:
        inst_name = str(items[0])
        device_prefix = inst_name[0].upper()

        tokens: list[Token] = []
        params: dict[str, ParameterValue] = {}
        for item in items[1:]:
            if isinstance(item, tuple):
                pname, pval = item
                if isinstance(pval, ParameterValue):
                    params[pname] = pval
                else:
                    params[pname] = ParameterValue()
            elif isinstance(item, Token):
                tokens.append(item)

        port_template = DEVICE_PORT_TEMPLATES.get(device_prefix)

        if device_prefix == "X":
            # Subcircuit instance: last token is subcircuit name, rest are nets
            model_or_subckt = str(tokens[-1]) if tokens else ""
            net_names = [str(t) for t in tokens[:-1]]
            return InstanceData(
                name=inst_name,
                net_names=net_names,
                model_or_subckt=model_or_subckt,
                value=None,
                params=params,
                device_prefix=device_prefix,
            )

        if port_template is not None:
            n_ports = len(port_template)
            token_strs = [str(t) for t in tokens]

            # Devices like R, C, L: after ports, next token is value or model name
            net_names = token_strs[:n_ports]
            remaining = token_strs[n_ports:]

            value: PrefixedValue | None = None
            model_name = ""
            for tok in remaining:
                if is_si_number(tok):
                    value = parse_si_number(tok)
                else:
                    model_name = tok

            return InstanceData(
                name=inst_name,
                net_names=net_names,
                model_or_subckt=model_name,
                value=value,
                params=params,
                device_prefix=device_prefix,
            )

        # Unknown device prefix — treat like subcircuit instance
        model_or_subckt = str(tokens[-1]) if tokens else ""
        net_names = [str(t) for t in tokens[:-1]]
        return InstanceData(
            name=inst_name,
            net_names=net_names,
            model_or_subckt=model_or_subckt,
            value=None,
            params=params,
            device_prefix=device_prefix,
        )

    # ── .model ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def model_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> ModelData:
        # items[0] = MODEL_KW, items[1] = model name, items[2] = type, rest = params
        name = str(items[1])
        type_name = str(items[2])
        params: dict[str, ParameterValue] = {}
        for item in items[3:]:
            if isinstance(item, tuple):
                pname, pval = item
                if isinstance(pval, ParameterValue):
                    params[pname] = pval
        return ModelData(name=name, type_name=type_name, params=params)

    # ── .param ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def param_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> ParamData:
        params: dict[str, ParameterValue] = {}
        for item in items:
            if isinstance(item, tuple):
                pname, pval = item
                if isinstance(pval, ParameterValue):
                    params[pname] = pval
        return ParamData(params=params)

    # ── .include / .lib ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def include_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> IncludeData:
        path = str(items[1]).strip("\"'")
        return IncludeData(path=path)

    def lib_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> LibData:
        path = str(items[1]).strip("\"'")
        section = (
            str(items[2]) if len(items) > 2 and not isinstance(items[2], Token) else ""
        )
        if len(items) > 2 and isinstance(items[2], Token):
            section = str(items[2])
        return LibData(path=path, section=section)

    # ── .global ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def global_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> GlobalData:
        nets = [
            str(t) for t in items if isinstance(t, Token) and not str(t).startswith(".")
        ]
        return GlobalData(nets=nets)

    # ── .option ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def option_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> OptionData:
        options: dict[str, str] = {}
        for item in items:
            if isinstance(item, tuple):
                pname, pval = item
                if isinstance(pval, ParameterValue):
                    options[pname] = _param_value_to_str(pval)
                else:
                    options[pname] = str(pval)
        return OptionData(options=options)

    # ── .end ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def end_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> None:
        return None

    # ── Simulation: analysis statements ─────────────────────────────────

    def _extract_sim_args(self, items: list[Any]) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, str]]:
        args: list[str] = []
        opts: dict[str, str] = {}
        for item in items:
            if isinstance(item, tuple):
                pname, pval = item
                if isinstance(pval, ParameterValue):
                    opts[pname] = _param_value_to_str(pval)
                else:
                    opts[pname] = str(pval)
            elif isinstance(item, Token):
                val = str(item)
                if not val.startswith("."):
                    args.append(val)
        return args, opts

    def token_output_var(self, items: list[Token]) -> Token:
        return items[0]

    def op_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        return AnalysisData(kind="op", arguments=[], options={})

    def tran_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="tran", arguments=args, options=opts)

    def ac_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="ac", arguments=args, options=opts)

    def dc_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="dc", arguments=args, options=opts)

    def noise_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="noise", arguments=args, options=opts)

    def tf_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="tf", arguments=args, options=opts)

    def sens_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="sens", arguments=args, options=opts)

    def pz_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="pz", arguments=args, options=opts)

    def disto_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="disto", arguments=args, options=opts)

    def four_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> AnalysisData:
        args, opts = self._extract_sim_args(items)
        return AnalysisData(kind="four", arguments=args, options=opts)

    # ── Simulation: output requests ─────────────────────────────────────

    def print_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> OutputRequestData:
        tokens = [
            str(t) for t in items if isinstance(t, Token) and not str(t).startswith(".")
        ]
        analysis_type = tokens[0] if tokens else ""
        variables = tokens[1:]
        return OutputRequestData(
            kind="print", analysis_type=analysis_type, variables=variables
        )

    def plot_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> OutputRequestData:
        tokens = [
            str(t) for t in items if isinstance(t, Token) and not str(t).startswith(".")
        ]
        analysis_type = tokens[0] if tokens else ""
        variables = tokens[1:]
        return OutputRequestData(
            kind="plot", analysis_type=analysis_type, variables=variables
        )

    def probe_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> OutputRequestData:
        tokens = [
            str(t) for t in items if isinstance(t, Token) and not str(t).startswith(".")
        ]
        analysis_type = tokens[0] if tokens else ""
        variables = tokens[1:]
        return OutputRequestData(
            kind="probe", analysis_type=analysis_type, variables=variables
        )

    # ── Simulation: measurements ────────────────────────────────────────

    def meas_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> MeasurementData:
        tokens = [
            str(t) for t in items if isinstance(t, Token) and not str(t).startswith(".")
        ]
        opts: list[str] = []
        for item in items:
            if isinstance(item, tuple):
                pname, pval = item
                if isinstance(pval, ParameterValue):
                    opts.append(f"{pname}={_param_value_to_str(pval)}")
                else:
                    opts.append(f"{pname}={pval}")
        analysis_type = tokens[0] if tokens else ""
        name = tokens[1] if len(tokens) > 1 else ""
        body_parts = tokens[2:] + opts
        return MeasurementData(
            name=name,
            analysis_type=analysis_type,
            body=" ".join(body_parts),
        )

    # ── Simulation: initial conditions ──────────────────────────────────

    def ic_assign(self, items: list[Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        var_name = str(items[0])
        value = items[1]
        if isinstance(value, ParameterValue):
            return (var_name, _param_value_to_str(value))
        return (var_name, str(value))

    def ic_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> InitialConditionData:
        conditions = {
            k: v for item in items if isinstance(item, tuple) for k, v in [item]
        }
        return InitialConditionData(kind="ic", conditions=conditions)

    def nodeset_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> InitialConditionData:
        conditions = {
            k: v for item in items if isinstance(item, tuple) for k, v in [item]
        }
        return InitialConditionData(kind="nodeset", conditions=conditions)

    # ── Simulation: temperature ─────────────────────────────────────────

    def temp_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> TemperatureData:
        temps: list[float] = []
        for item in items:
            if isinstance(item, Token):
                val = str(item)
                if val.startswith("."):
                    continue
                try:
                    temps.append(float(val))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
        return TemperatureData(temperatures=temps)

    # ── Subcircuit body & definition ────────────────────────────────────

    def subckt_body(self, items: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
        return [i for i in items if i is not None]

    def port_decl(self, items: list[Token]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """Tag port declarations so they are distinguishable from raw tokens."""
        return ("__port__", str(items[0]))

    def subckt_def(self, items: list[Any]) -> SubcktData:
        # After transform, items are:
        #   Token(SUBCKT_KW), Token(IDENT=name),
        #   ("__port__", name)*, (param_name, param_val)*,
        #   body_list,
        #   Token(ENDS_KW), Token(IDENT=end_name)?
        subckt_name = str(items[1])

        port_names: list[str] = []
        subckt_params: dict[str, ParameterValue] = {}
        body_items: list[Any] = []

        for item in items[2:]:
            if isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 2 and item[0] == "__port__":
                port_names.append(item[1])
            elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 2 and item[0] != "__port__":
                pname, pval = item
                if isinstance(pval, ParameterValue):
                    subckt_params[pname] = pval
            elif isinstance(item, list):
                body_items = item

        result = self.build_subckt(subckt_name, port_names, subckt_params, body_items)
        self.all_subckts[subckt_name] = result.circuit
        return result

    def build_subckt(
        self,
        name: str,
        port_names: list[str],
        subckt_params: dict[str, ParameterValue],
        body_items: list[Any],
    ) -> SubcktData:
        """Assemble a Circuit from parsed subcircuit contents.

        O(n) overall: single pass over body items to collect instances,
        single pass to build NetMap, single pass to generate Connections.
        """
        instances: list[InstanceData] = []
        nested_subckts: dict[str, Circuit] = {}
        ext_circuits: dict[str, ExternalCircuit] = {}
        model_defs: dict[str, ModelData] = {}
        circuit_params: list[Parameter] = []
        directives: list[Directive] = []

        # Single pass: classify body items by type — O(n)
        for item in body_items:
            if isinstance(item, InstanceData):
                instances.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, SubcktData):
                nested_subckts[item.circuit.name] = item.circuit
                ext_circuits.update(item.ext_circuits)
            elif isinstance(item, ModelData):
                model_defs[item.name] = item
            elif isinstance(item, ParamData):
                for pname, pval in item.params.items():
                    circuit_params.append(Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval))
            elif isinstance(item, IncludeData):
                directives.append(
                    Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.INCLUDE, value=item.path)
                )
            elif isinstance(item, GlobalData):
                directives.append(
                    Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.GLOBAL, value=" ".join(item.nets))
                )
            elif isinstance(item, OptionData):
                for k, v in item.options.items():
                    directives.append(
                        Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.OPTION, name=k, value=v)
                    )

        # Add subckt-level params
        for pname, pval in subckt_params.items():
            circuit_params.append(Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval))

        # Build ports — O(p)
        ports: list[Port] = []
        for pname in port_names:
            ports.append(
                Port(
                    name=pname,
                    direction=PortDirection.INOUT,
                    domain=domain_of(pname),
                )
            )

        # Build subcircuits and NetMap from instances — O(n * avg_ports)
        net_map: NetMap = {}
        subcircuits: list[SubCircuit] = []

        # Register the circuit's own ports on their nets (port name = net name)
        for port in ports:
            add_port_to_net(net_map, port.name, "", port.name)

        for inst in instances:
            device_prefix = inst.device_prefix
            port_template = DEVICE_PORT_TEMPLATES.get(device_prefix)

            if device_prefix == "X":
                # Subcircuit instance: resolve port names from local or global registry
                subckt_mod = nested_subckts.get(
                    inst.model_or_subckt
                ) or self.all_subckts.get(inst.model_or_subckt)
                if subckt_mod is not None:
                    inst_port_names = [p.name for p in subckt_mod.ports]
                else:
                    inst_port_names = [f"p{i}" for i in range(len(inst.net_names))]

                for net_name, port_name in zip(inst.net_names, inst_port_names):
                    add_port_to_net(net_map, net_name, inst.name, port_name)

                subcircuits.append(
                    SubCircuit(
                        name=inst.name,
                        circuit_name=inst.model_or_subckt,
                        parameters=[
                            Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval)
                            for pname, pval in inst.params.items()
                        ],
                    )
                )
            elif port_template is not None:
                # Primitive device instance
                module_name = DEVICE_PREFIX_TO_CIRCUIT.get(
                    device_prefix, device_prefix.lower()
                )

                for net_name, port_name in zip(inst.net_names, port_template):
                    add_port_to_net(net_map, net_name, inst.name, port_name)

                # Build ExternalCircuit if not yet seen — O(1) amortized
                if module_name not in ext_circuits:
                    ext_ports = [
                        Port(
                            name=pn,
                            direction=PortDirection.INOUT,
                            domain=domain_of(pn),
                        )
                        for pn in port_template
                    ]
                    ext_circuits[module_name] = ExternalCircuit(
                        name=module_name,
                        ports=ext_ports,
                        properties={"spice_prefix": device_prefix},
                    )

                params: list[Parameter] = []
                if inst.value is not None:
                    params.append(
                        Parameter(
                            name="value",
                            default_value=ParameterValue(prefixed_value=inst.value),
                        )
                    )
                for pname, pval in inst.params.items():
                    params.append(Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval))

                props: dict[str, str] = {}
                if inst.model_or_subckt:
                    props["model_name"] = inst.model_or_subckt

                subcircuits.append(
                    SubCircuit(
                        name=inst.name,
                        circuit_name=module_name,
                        parameters=params,
                        properties=props,
                    )
                )
            else:
                # Unknown prefix — treat as subcircuit
                for i, net_name in enumerate(inst.net_names):
                    add_port_to_net(net_map, net_name, inst.name, f"p{i}")
                subcircuits.append(
                    SubCircuit(
                        name=inst.name,
                        circuit_name=inst.model_or_subckt,
                        parameters=[
                            Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval)
                            for pname, pval in inst.params.items()
                        ],
                    )
                )

        # Convert model definitions to ExternalCircuits
        for mdata in model_defs.values():
            if mdata.name not in ext_circuits:
                ext_params = [
                    Parameter(name=pn, default_value=pv)
                    for pn, pv in mdata.params.items()
                ]
                ext_circuits[mdata.name] = ExternalCircuit(
                    name=mdata.name,
                    parameters=ext_params,
                    properties={"model_type": mdata.type_name},
                )

        # Convert NetMap to Connections — O(n)
        connections: list[Connection] = net_map_to_connections(net_map)

        circuit = Circuit(
            name=name,
            ports=ports,
            parameters=circuit_params,
            subcircuits=subcircuits,
            connections=connections,
            directives=directives,
        )

        return SubcktData(circuit=circuit, ext_circuits=ext_circuits)

    # ── Top-level: start ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def start(self, items: list[Any]) -> Netlist:
        subckt_datas: list[SubcktData] = []
        model_defs: dict[str, ModelData] = {}
        top_instances: list[InstanceData] = []
        circuit_params: list[Parameter] = []
        directives: list[Directive] = []
        analyses: list[AnalysisData] = []
        output_requests: list[OutputRequestData] = []
        measurements: list[MeasurementData] = []
        ic_data: InitialConditionData | None = None
        nodeset_data: InitialConditionData | None = None
        temperatures: list[float] = []

        # Single pass over top-level items — O(n)
        for item in items:
            if item is None:
                continue
            if isinstance(item, SubcktData):
                subckt_datas.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, ModelData):
                model_defs[item.name] = item
            elif isinstance(item, InstanceData):
                top_instances.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, ParamData):
                for pname, pval in item.params.items():
                    circuit_params.append(Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval))
            elif isinstance(item, IncludeData):
                directives.append(
                    Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.INCLUDE, value=item.path)
                )
            elif isinstance(item, LibData):
                val = item.path
                if item.section:
                    val += f" {item.section}"
                directives.append(Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.LIB, value=val))
            elif isinstance(item, GlobalData):
                directives.append(
                    Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.GLOBAL, value=" ".join(item.nets))
                )
            elif isinstance(item, OptionData):
                for k, v in item.options.items():
                    directives.append(
                        Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.OPTION, name=k, value=v)
                    )
            elif isinstance(item, AnalysisData):
                analyses.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, OutputRequestData):
                output_requests.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, MeasurementData):
                measurements.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, InitialConditionData):
                if item.kind == "ic":
                    if ic_data is None:
                        ic_data = item
                    else:
                        ic_data.conditions.update(item.conditions)
                else:
                    if nodeset_data is None:
                        nodeset_data = item
                    else:
                        nodeset_data.conditions.update(item.conditions)
            elif isinstance(item, TemperatureData):
                temperatures.extend(item.temperatures)

        # Collect all circuits and ext_modules from subcircuit definitions
        circuits: list[Circuit] = []
        all_ext_circuits: dict[str, ExternalCircuit] = {}
        subckt_by_name: dict[str, Circuit] = {}

        for sd in subckt_datas:
            circuits.append(sd.circuit)
            subckt_by_name[sd.circuit.name] = sd.circuit
            all_ext_circuits.update(sd.ext_circuits)

        # If there are top-level instances, create a synthetic top circuit
        if top_instances:
            top_data = self.build_subckt(
                name="__top__",
                port_names=[],
                subckt_params={},
                body_items=top_instances,
            )
            circuits.insert(0, top_data.circuit)
            all_ext_circuits.update(top_data.ext_circuits)

        # Convert model definitions to ExternalCircuits
        for mdata in model_defs.values():
            if mdata.name not in all_ext_circuits:
                ext_params = [
                    Parameter(name=pn, default_value=pv)
                    for pn, pv in mdata.params.items()
                ]
                all_ext_circuits[mdata.name] = ExternalCircuit(
                    name=mdata.name,
                    parameters=ext_params,
                    properties={"model_type": mdata.type_name},
                )

        # Determine top circuit: last defined subcircuit is conventionally the top
        top_circuit = ""
        if circuits:
            top_circuit = circuits[-1].name

        for p in circuit_params:
            val = _param_value_to_str(p.default_value) if p.default_value else ""
            directives.append(
                Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.PARAM, name=p.name, value=val)
            )

        # Build Simulation object if any simulation data was found
        simulation: Simulation | None = None
        if (
            analyses
            or output_requests
            or measurements
            or ic_data
            or nodeset_data
            or temperatures
        ):
            simulation = Simulation(
                analyses=[
                    Analysis(
                        kind=ANALYSIS_KIND_MAP.get(a.kind),
                        name=a.name,
                        arguments=a.arguments,
                        options=a.options,
                    )
                    for a in analyses
                ],
                output_requests=[
                    OutputRequest(
                        kind=OUTPUT_REQUEST_KIND_MAP.get(o.kind),
                        analysis_type=o.analysis_type,
                        variables=o.variables,
                    )
                    for o in output_requests
                ],
                measurements=[
                    Measurement(
                        name=m.name,
                        analysis_type=m.analysis_type,
                        body=m.body,
                    )
                    for m in measurements
                ],
                initial_conditions=(
                    InitialCondition(conditions=ic_data.conditions) if ic_data else None
                ),
                node_sets=(
                    InitialCondition(conditions=nodeset_data.conditions)
                    if nodeset_data
                    else None
                ),
                temperatures=temperatures,
            )

        return Netlist(
            name="",
            top_circuit=top_circuit,
            circuits=circuits,
            ext_circuits=list(all_ext_circuits.values()),
            directives=directives,
            simulation=simulation,
        )

build_subckt(
    name: str,
    port_names: list[str],
    subckt_params: dict[str, ParameterValue],
    body_items: list[Any],
) -> SubcktData

Assemble a Circuit from parsed subcircuit contents.

O(n) overall: single pass over body items to collect instances, single pass to build NetMap, single pass to generate Connections.

Source code in src/kfnetlist/morphnet/netlist/spice/transformer.py 
def build_subckt(
    self,
    name: str,
    port_names: list[str],
    subckt_params: dict[str, ParameterValue],
    body_items: list[Any],
) -> SubcktData:
    """Assemble a Circuit from parsed subcircuit contents.

    O(n) overall: single pass over body items to collect instances,
    single pass to build NetMap, single pass to generate Connections.
    """
    instances: list[InstanceData] = []
    nested_subckts: dict[str, Circuit] = {}
    ext_circuits: dict[str, ExternalCircuit] = {}
    model_defs: dict[str, ModelData] = {}
    circuit_params: list[Parameter] = []
    directives: list[Directive] = []

    # Single pass: classify body items by type — O(n)
    for item in body_items:
        if isinstance(item, InstanceData):
            instances.append(item)
        elif isinstance(item, SubcktData):
            nested_subckts[item.circuit.name] = item.circuit
            ext_circuits.update(item.ext_circuits)
        elif isinstance(item, ModelData):
            model_defs[item.name] = item
        elif isinstance(item, ParamData):
            for pname, pval in item.params.items():
                circuit_params.append(Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval))
        elif isinstance(item, IncludeData):
            directives.append(
                Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.INCLUDE, value=item.path)
            )
        elif isinstance(item, GlobalData):
            directives.append(
                Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.GLOBAL, value=" ".join(item.nets))
            )
        elif isinstance(item, OptionData):
            for k, v in item.options.items():
                directives.append(
                    Directive(kind=DirectiveKind.OPTION, name=k, value=v)
                )

    # Add subckt-level params
    for pname, pval in subckt_params.items():
        circuit_params.append(Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval))

    # Build ports — O(p)
    ports: list[Port] = []
    for pname in port_names:
        ports.append(
            Port(
                name=pname,
                direction=PortDirection.INOUT,
                domain=domain_of(pname),
            )
        )

    # Build subcircuits and NetMap from instances — O(n * avg_ports)
    net_map: NetMap = {}
    subcircuits: list[SubCircuit] = []

    # Register the circuit's own ports on their nets (port name = net name)
    for port in ports:
        add_port_to_net(net_map, port.name, "", port.name)

    for inst in instances:
        device_prefix = inst.device_prefix
        port_template = DEVICE_PORT_TEMPLATES.get(device_prefix)

        if device_prefix == "X":
            # Subcircuit instance: resolve port names from local or global registry
            subckt_mod = nested_subckts.get(
                inst.model_or_subckt
            ) or self.all_subckts.get(inst.model_or_subckt)
            if subckt_mod is not None:
                inst_port_names = [p.name for p in subckt_mod.ports]
            else:
                inst_port_names = [f"p{i}" for i in range(len(inst.net_names))]

            for net_name, port_name in zip(inst.net_names, inst_port_names):
                add_port_to_net(net_map, net_name, inst.name, port_name)

            subcircuits.append(
                SubCircuit(
                    name=inst.name,
                    circuit_name=inst.model_or_subckt,
                    parameters=[
                        Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval)
                        for pname, pval in inst.params.items()
                    ],
                )
            )
        elif port_template is not None:
            # Primitive device instance
            module_name = DEVICE_PREFIX_TO_CIRCUIT.get(
                device_prefix, device_prefix.lower()
            )

            for net_name, port_name in zip(inst.net_names, port_template):
                add_port_to_net(net_map, net_name, inst.name, port_name)

            # Build ExternalCircuit if not yet seen — O(1) amortized
            if module_name not in ext_circuits:
                ext_ports = [
                    Port(
                        name=pn,
                        direction=PortDirection.INOUT,
                        domain=domain_of(pn),
                    )
                    for pn in port_template
                ]
                ext_circuits[module_name] = ExternalCircuit(
                    name=module_name,
                    ports=ext_ports,
                    properties={"spice_prefix": device_prefix},
                )

            params: list[Parameter] = []
            if inst.value is not None:
                params.append(
                    Parameter(
                        name="value",
                        default_value=ParameterValue(prefixed_value=inst.value),
                    )
                )
            for pname, pval in inst.params.items():
                params.append(Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval))

            props: dict[str, str] = {}
            if inst.model_or_subckt:
                props["model_name"] = inst.model_or_subckt

            subcircuits.append(
                SubCircuit(
                    name=inst.name,
                    circuit_name=module_name,
                    parameters=params,
                    properties=props,
                )
            )
        else:
            # Unknown prefix — treat as subcircuit
            for i, net_name in enumerate(inst.net_names):
                add_port_to_net(net_map, net_name, inst.name, f"p{i}")
            subcircuits.append(
                SubCircuit(
                    name=inst.name,
                    circuit_name=inst.model_or_subckt,
                    parameters=[
                        Parameter(name=pname, default_value=pval)
                        for pname, pval in inst.params.items()
                    ],
                )
            )

    # Convert model definitions to ExternalCircuits
    for mdata in model_defs.values():
        if mdata.name not in ext_circuits:
            ext_params = [
                Parameter(name=pn, default_value=pv)
                for pn, pv in mdata.params.items()
            ]
            ext_circuits[mdata.name] = ExternalCircuit(
                name=mdata.name,
                parameters=ext_params,
                properties={"model_type": mdata.type_name},
            )

    # Convert NetMap to Connections — O(n)
    connections: list[Connection] = net_map_to_connections(net_map)

    circuit = Circuit(
        name=name,
        ports=ports,
        parameters=circuit_params,
        subcircuits=subcircuits,
        connections=connections,
        directives=directives,
    )

    return SubcktData(circuit=circuit, ext_circuits=ext_circuits)

items.title: SpiceWriter
items.text:
Convert a Netlist model to SPICE netlist text.

All lookups use dict-based O(1) access.

Source code in src/kfnetlist/morphnet/netlist/spice/writer.py 
class SpiceWriter:
    """Convert a Netlist model to SPICE netlist text.

    All lookups use dict-based O(1) access.
    """

    def format_param_value(self, pval: ParameterValue) -> str:
        """Format any ParameterValue variant as a SPICE-compatible string."""
        if pval.prefixed_value is not None:
            return format_si_value(pval.prefixed_value)
        return "0"

    def write(self, netlist: Netlist) -> str:
        lines: list[str] = []

        # Title line
        title = netlist.name or "untitled"
        lines.append(f"* {title}")

        # Build lookups — O(e + m)
        ext_by_name: dict[str, ExternalCircuit] = {
            e.name: e for e in netlist.ext_circuits
        }
        circuit_by_name: dict[str, Circuit] = {m.name: m for m in netlist.circuits}

        self.write_directives(netlist.directives, lines)

        for ext in netlist.ext_circuits:
            model_type = ext.properties.get("model_type", "")
            if model_type:
                self.write_model(ext, model_type, lines)

        # Emit subcircuit definitions
        for circuit in netlist.circuits:
            if circuit.name == "__top__":
                self.write_top_instances(circuit, ext_by_name, circuit_by_name, lines)
            else:
                self.write_subckt(circuit, ext_by_name, circuit_by_name, lines)

        if netlist.simulation:
            self.write_simulation(netlist.simulation, lines)

        lines.append(".end")
        lines.append("")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def write_directives(self, directives: list[Directive], lines: list[str]) -> None:
        for d in directives:
            if d.kind == DirectiveKind.INCLUDE:
                lines.append(f'.include "{d.value}"')
            elif d.kind == DirectiveKind.LIB:
                lines.append(f".lib {d.value}")
            elif d.kind == DirectiveKind.GLOBAL:
                lines.append(f".global {d.value}")
            elif d.kind == DirectiveKind.OPTION:
                lines.append(f".option {d.name}={d.value}")
            elif d.kind == DirectiveKind.PARAM:
                lines.append(f".param {d.name}={d.value}")

    def write_model(
        self,
        ext: ExternalCircuit,
        model_type: str,
        lines: list[str],
    ) -> None:
        """Emit a .model statement."""
        param_strs: list[str] = []
        for p in ext.parameters:
            if p.default_value:
                param_strs.append(
                    f"{p.name}={self.format_param_value(p.default_value)}"
                )
        params_text = " ".join(param_strs)
        if params_text:
            lines.append(f".model {ext.name} {model_type} {params_text}")
        else:
            lines.append(f".model {ext.name} {model_type}")

    def write_subckt(
        self,
        circuit: Circuit,
        ext_by_name: dict[str, ExternalCircuit],
        circuit_by_name: dict[str, Circuit],
        lines: list[str],
    ) -> None:
        """Emit a .subckt / .ends block."""
        port_names = " ".join(p.name for p in circuit.ports)
        lines.append(f".subckt {circuit.name} {port_names}")

        # Emit .param for circuit parameters
        for param in circuit.parameters:
            if param.default_value:
                val = self.format_param_value(param.default_value)
                lines.append(f".param {param.name}={val}")

        # Build (instance_name, port_name) → net_name — O(c)
        inst_nets = connections_to_instance_nets(circuit.connections)

        # Emit instances
        for ref in circuit.subcircuits:
            lines.append(
                self.write_instance(ref, inst_nets, ext_by_name, circuit_by_name)
            )

        lines.append(f".ends {circuit.name}")

    def write_top_instances(
        self,
        circuit: Circuit,
        ext_by_name: dict[str, ExternalCircuit],
        circuit_by_name: dict[str, Circuit],
        lines: list[str],
    ) -> None:
        """Emit top-level instances (outside any subcircuit)."""
        inst_nets = connections_to_instance_nets(circuit.connections)
        for ref in circuit.subcircuits:
            lines.append(
                self.write_instance(ref, inst_nets, ext_by_name, circuit_by_name)
            )

    def write_instance(
        self,
        ref: SubCircuit,
        inst_nets: dict[tuple[str, str], str],
        ext_by_name: dict[str, ExternalCircuit],
        circuit_by_name: dict[str, Circuit],
    ) -> str:
        """Emit a single instance line.

        Device prefix and port order determined by O(1) dict lookups.
        """
        prefix = CIRCUIT_TO_PREFIX.get(ref.circuit_name)
        ext_circuit = ext_by_name.get(ref.circuit_name)

        if prefix:
            # Primitive device: R1 net1 net2 value param=val ...
            inst_name = ref.name
            port_order = (
                [p.name for p in ext_circuit.ports]
                if ext_circuit
                else DEVICE_PORT_TEMPLATES[prefix]
            )
            nets = [inst_nets.get((inst_name, pn), "?") for pn in port_order]
            nets_str = " ".join(nets)

            model_name = ref.properties.get("model_name", "")
            value_str = ""
            other_params: list[str] = []
            for param in ref.parameters:
                if param.name == "value" and param.default_value:
                    value_str = self.format_param_value(param.default_value)
                elif param.default_value:
                    other_params.append(
                        f"{param.name}={self.format_param_value(param.default_value)}"
                    )

            parts = [inst_name, nets_str]
            if model_name:
                parts.append(model_name)
            if value_str:
                parts.append(value_str)
            parts.extend(other_params)
            return " ".join(parts)

        # Subcircuit instance: X1 net1 net2 ... subckt_name param=val
        inst_name = ref.name
        subckt_name = ref.circuit_name

        ref_circuit = circuit_by_name.get(subckt_name)
        if ref_circuit is not None:
            port_order = [p.name for p in ref_circuit.ports]
        elif ext_circuit is not None:
            port_order = [p.name for p in ext_circuit.ports]
        else:
            port_order = self.infer_port_order(ref, inst_nets)

        nets = [inst_nets.get((inst_name, pn), "?") for pn in port_order]
        nets_str = " ".join(nets)

        params_parts = [
            f"{p.name}={self.format_param_value(p.default_value)}"
            for p in ref.parameters
            if p.default_value
        ]
        parts = [inst_name, nets_str, subckt_name]
        parts.extend(params_parts)
        return " ".join(parts)

    def infer_port_order(
        self,
        ref: SubCircuit,
        inst_nets: dict[tuple[str, str], str],
    ) -> list[str]:
        """Infer port order from the instance-net map when no circuit definition is available."""
        port_names: list[str] = []
        for iname, pname in inst_nets:
            if iname == ref.name and pname not in port_names:
                port_names.append(pname)
        return port_names

    # ── Simulation writing ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    def write_simulation(self, simulation: Simulation, lines: list[str]) -> None:
        for analysis in simulation.analyses:
            lines.append(self.format_analysis(analysis))
        for req in simulation.output_requests:
            lines.append(self.format_output_request(req))
        for meas in simulation.measurements:
            lines.append(self.format_measurement(meas))
        if simulation.initial_conditions:
            assigns = " ".join(
                f"{k}={v}" for k, v in simulation.initial_conditions.conditions.items()
            )
            lines.append(f".ic {assigns}")
        if simulation.node_sets:
            assigns = " ".join(
                f"{k}={v}" for k, v in simulation.node_sets.conditions.items()
            )
            lines.append(f".nodeset {assigns}")
        if simulation.temperatures:
            temps = " ".join(str(t) for t in simulation.temperatures)
            lines.append(f".temp {temps}")

    def format_analysis(self, analysis: Analysis) -> str:
        keyword = _ANALYSIS_KIND_TO_KW.get(analysis.kind, ".op")
        parts = [keyword]
        parts.extend(analysis.arguments)
        for k, v in analysis.options.items():
            parts.append(f"{k}={v}")
        return " ".join(parts)

    def format_output_request(self, req: OutputRequest) -> str:
        keyword = _OUTPUT_REQUEST_KIND_TO_KW.get(req.kind, ".print")
        parts = [keyword]
        if req.analysis_type:
            parts.append(req.analysis_type)
        parts.extend(req.variables)
        return " ".join(parts)

    def format_measurement(self, meas: Measurement) -> str:
        parts = [".meas"]
        if meas.analysis_type:
            parts.append(meas.analysis_type)
        if meas.name:
            parts.append(meas.name)
        if meas.body:
            parts.append(meas.body)
        return " ".join(parts)

def write_subckt(
    self,
    circuit: Circuit,
    ext_by_name: dict[str, ExternalCircuit],
    circuit_by_name: dict[str, Circuit],
    lines: list[str],
) -> None:
    """Emit a .subckt / .ends block."""
    port_names = " ".join(p.name for p in circuit.ports)
    lines.append(f".subckt {circuit.name} {port_names}")

    # Emit .param for circuit parameters
    for param in circuit.parameters:
        if param.default_value:
            val = self.format_param_value(param.default_value)
            lines.append(f".param {param.name}={val}")

    # Build (instance_name, port_name) → net_name — O(c)
    inst_nets = connections_to_instance_nets(circuit.connections)

    # Emit instances
    for ref in circuit.subcircuits:
        lines.append(
            self.write_instance(ref, inst_nets, ext_by_name, circuit_by_name)
        )

    lines.append(f".ends {circuit.name}")

class SystemVerilogParser:
    """Parse structural SystemVerilog text into a Netlist model."""

    lark_instance: ClassVar[Lark | None] = None

    @classmethod
    def get_lark(cls) -> Lark:
        if cls.lark_instance is None:
            grammar_text = (
                resource_files("kfnetlist.morphnet.netlist.grammars")
                .joinpath("systemverilog.lark")
                .read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            )
            cls.lark_instance = Lark(grammar_text, parser="lalr")
        return cls.lark_instance

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, text: str) -> Netlist:
        result = preprocess_systemverilog(text)
        directives: list[Directive] = []
        for kind_str, value in result.directives:
            dk = DIRECTIVE_KIND_MAP.get(kind_str, DirectiveKind.UNSPECIFIED)
            if dk == DirectiveKind.INCLUDE:
                value = value.strip("\"'")
            directives.append(Directive(kind=dk, value=value))
        tree = cls.get_lark().parse(result.text)
        try:
            return SystemVerilogTransformer(result.blocks, directives).transform(tree)
        except VisitError as e:
            raise e.orig_exc from None

  1. Strip block comments, line comments and (* attributes *).
  2. Extract backtick directives (include,define, `timescale, etc.).
  3. Replace behavioral constructs (always, initial, function, task, generate, class, non-trivial assign, ...) with __sv_placeholder__ N ; markers. typedef / import / genvar / timeunit statements are dropped.
Source code in src/kfnetlist/morphnet/netlist/systemverilog/preprocess.py 
def preprocess_systemverilog(text: str) -> SvPreprocessResult:
    """Prepare SystemVerilog text for Lark parsing.

    1. Strip block comments, line comments and ``(* attributes *)``.
    2. Extract backtick directives (`include, `define, `timescale, etc.).
    3. Replace behavioral constructs (always, initial, function, task, generate,
       class, non-trivial assign, ...) with ``__sv_placeholder__ N ;`` markers.
       typedef / import / genvar / timeunit statements are dropped.
    """
    text = BLOCK_COMMENT_RE.sub("", text)
    text = LINE_COMMENT_RE.sub("", text)
    text = ATTRIBUTE_RE.sub("", text)

    directives = [(m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()) for m in DIRECTIVE_RE.finditer(text)]
    text = DIRECTIVE_RE.sub("", text)

    text, blocks = replace_behavioral_blocks(text)

    text = re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n", text).strip()
    if text:
        text += "\n"
    return SvPreprocessResult(text=text, directives=directives, blocks=blocks)

Source code in src/kfnetlist/morphnet/netlist/systemverilog/preprocess.py 
def replace_behavioral_blocks(text: str) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """Replace non-structural constructs with numbered placeholder tokens."""
    blocks: list[str] = []
    out: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    while (m := CONSTRUCT_RE.search(text, i)) is not None:
        kw = m.group(1).split()[-1]
        if kw in END_KEYWORDS:
            end = _match_end(text, m.end(), kw, END_KEYWORDS[kw])
        elif kw in PROCEDURAL:
            end = _skip_statement(text, m.end())
        else:
            end = _skip_to_semicolon(text, m.end())
        stmt = text[m.start() : end]
        out.append(text[i : m.start()])
        if kw == "assign" and SIMPLE_ASSIGN_RE.fullmatch(stmt):
            out.append(stmt)
        elif kw not in DROPPED:
            out.append(f" __sv_placeholder__ {len(blocks)} ;")
            blocks.append(stmt.strip())
        i = end
    out.append(text[i:])
    return "".join(out), blocks

class SystemVerilogTransformer(Transformer[Token, Netlist]):
    """Transform a SystemVerilog parse tree into a Netlist model."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        blocks: list[str] | None = None,
        directives: list[Directive] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.blocks = blocks or []
        self.directives = directives or []

    # ── Expressions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def number(self, items: list[Token]) -> Literal:
        return Literal(items[0])

    def sized_number(self, items: list[Token]) -> Literal:
        return Literal(re.sub(r"\s+", "", str(items[0])))

    def string(self, items: list[Token]) -> str:
        return str(items[0])

    def binop(self, items: list[Any]) -> str:
        return f"{items[0]}{items[1]}{items[2]}"

    def unop(self, items: list[Any]) -> str:
        return f"{items[0]}{items[1]}"

    def paren(self, items: list[Any]) -> str:
        return f"({items[0]})"

    def range(self, items: list[Any]) -> str:
        return f"[{':'.join(items)}]"

    def dims(self, items: list[str]) -> str:
        return "".join(items)

    def net_ref(self, items: list[Any]) -> NetRef:
        return NetRef(_ident(items[0]) + "".join(items[1:]))

    # ── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def builtin_type(self, items: list[Any]) -> str:
        return str(items[0])

    def implicit_type(self, items: list[Any]) -> str:
        return ""

    def user_type(self, items: list[Token]) -> str:
        return _ident(items[0])

    # ── Parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def param_assign(self, items: list[Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        return _ident(items[0]), str(items[2])

    def _param_specs(self, items: list[Any], local_default: bool) -> list[ParamSpec]:
        local, ptype = local_default, ""
        specs = []
        for item in items:
            if isinstance(item, Token) and item.type == "PARAM_KW":
                local = str(item) == "localparam"
            elif isinstance(item, tuple):
                specs.append(ParamSpec(item[0], item[1], ptype, local))
            else:
                ptype = str(item)
        return specs

    def param_port(self, items: list[Any]) -> ParamSpec:
        return self._param_specs(items, local_default=False)[0]

    def param_port_list(self, items: list[ParamSpec]) -> HeaderParams:
        # `#(parameter real a = 1, b = 2)`: b inherits `real` from a
        for prev, spec in zip(items, items[1:]):
            if not spec.type:
                spec.type = prev.type
        return HeaderParams(items)

    def param_decl(self, items: list[Any]) -> list[ParamSpec]:
        return self._param_specs(items, local_default=False)

    # ── Ports ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def ansi_port(self, items: list[Any]) -> PortSpec:
        direction = ptype = None
        name = ""
        for item in items:
            if isinstance(item, Token) and item.type == "PORT_DIR":
                direction = str(item)
            elif isinstance(item, Token) and item.type == "IDENT":
                name = _ident(item)
            elif not name and isinstance(item, str):
                ptype = item
        return PortSpec(name, direction, ptype)

    def port_list(self, items: list[PortSpec]) -> list[PortSpec]:
        return items

    def port_decl(self, items: list[Any]) -> PortDecl:
        direction, ptype, names = str(items[0]), "", []
        for item in items[1:]:
            if isinstance(item, Token) and item.type == "IDENT":
                names.append(_ident(item))
            elif isinstance(item, str) and not names:
                ptype = item
        return PortDecl(direction, ptype, names)

    # ── Net / variable declarations ─────────────────────────────────────

    def decl_assign(self, items: list[Any]) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
        return _ident(items[0]), (items[2] if len(items) > 2 else None)

    def data_decl(self, items: list[Any]) -> DataDecl:
        return DataDecl(str(items[0]), items[1:])

    def user_decl(self, items: list[Any]) -> DataDecl:
        return DataDecl(_ident(items[0]), items[1:])

    # ── Instances ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def named_param(self, items: list[Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        return _ident(items[0]), (str(items[1]) if len(items) > 1 else "")

    def ordered_param(self, items: list[Any]) -> str:
        return str(items[0])

    def param_values(self, items: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
        return items

    def named_conn(self, items: list[Any]) -> tuple[str, Any]:
        return _ident(items[0]), (items[1] if len(items) > 1 else None)

    def implicit_conn(self, items: list[Token]) -> tuple[str, Any]:
        return _ident(items[0]), IMPLICIT

    def wildcard_conn(self, items: list[Any]) -> str:
        return ".*"

    def ordered_conn(self, items: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
        return [items[0] if items else None]

    def hier_inst(self, items: list[Any]) -> HierInst:
        inst = HierInst(name=_ident(items[0]) + items[1])
        for conn in items[2:]:
            if conn == ".*":
                inst.wildcard = True
            elif isinstance(conn, tuple):
                inst.named[conn[0]] = conn[1]
            else:
                inst.ordered.extend(conn)
        if inst.ordered == [None]:  # `X1 ()`
            inst.ordered = []
        return inst

    def instance_stmt(self, items: list[Any]) -> InstanceStmt:
        stmt = InstanceStmt(_ident(items[0]), {}, [], [])
        for item in items[1:]:
            if isinstance(item, HierInst):
                stmt.instances.append(item)
            else:
                for arg in item:
                    if isinstance(arg, tuple):
                        stmt.named_params[arg[0]] = arg[1]
                    else:
                        stmt.ordered_params.append(arg)
        return stmt

    # ── assign / alias / placeholders ───────────────────────────────────

    def assign_stmt(self, items: list[NetRef]) -> list[Merge]:
        return [Merge([a, b]) for a, b in zip(items[::2], items[1::2])]

    def alias_stmt(self, items: list[NetRef]) -> Merge:
        return Merge(list(items))

    def placeholder(self, items: list[Token]) -> Placeholder:
        return Placeholder(int(str(items[0])))

    # ── Module ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def end_label(self, items: list[Token]) -> None:
        return None

    def module_def(self, items: list[Any]) -> ModuleData:
        module = ModuleData(_ident(items[0]), [], [], [])
        for item in items[1:]:
            if isinstance(item, HeaderParams):
                module.params = item
            elif isinstance(item, list) and item and isinstance(item[0], ParamSpec):
                module.items.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, list) and item and isinstance(item[0], PortSpec):
                module.ports = item
            elif isinstance(item, list):
                module.items.extend(item)  # assign a = b, c = d
            elif item is not None:
                module.items.append(item)
        return module

    # ── Top-level ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def start(self, items: list[Any]) -> Netlist:
        modules = {m.name: m for m in items if isinstance(m, ModuleData)}
        circuits = [self._build_circuit(m, modules) for m in modules.values()]
        properties = {
            f"behavioral_block_{p.index}": self.blocks[p.index]
            for p in items
            if isinstance(p, Placeholder) and p.index < len(self.blocks)
        }
        used = {s.circuit_name for c in circuits for s in c.subcircuits}
        tops = [c.name for c in circuits if c.name not in used] or [
            c.name for c in circuits
        ]
        return Netlist(
            top_circuit=tops[-1] if tops else "",
            circuits=circuits,
            properties=properties,
            directives=self.directives,
        )

    def _build_circuit(
        self, module: ModuleData, modules: dict[str, ModuleData]
    ) -> Circuit:
        # ── ports: ANSI header specs, completed by non-ANSI body declarations
        directions: dict[str, str] = {}
        types: dict[str, str] = {}
        ansi = any(p.direction or p.type for p in module.ports)
        prev_dir, prev_type = "inout", ""
        for spec in module.ports:
            if ansi and spec.direction is None and spec.type is None:
                spec.direction, spec.type = prev_dir, prev_type
            elif ansi and spec.direction is None:
                spec.direction = prev_dir
            if spec.direction:
                directions[spec.name] = spec.direction
                prev_dir, prev_type = spec.direction, spec.type or ""
            if spec.type:
                types[spec.name] = spec.type

        parameters: list[Parameter] = [self._parameter(p) for p in module.params]
        properties: dict[str, str] = {}
        merges: list[list[str]] = []
        instances: list[InstanceStmt] = []
        for item in module.items:
            if isinstance(item, PortDecl):
                for n in item.names:
                    directions[n] = item.direction
                    if item.type:
                        types[n] = item.type
            elif isinstance(item, DataDecl):
                for n, rhs in item.assigns:
                    types[n] = types.get(n) or item.type
                    if isinstance(rhs, NetRef):
                        merges.append([n, rhs])  # wire a = b;
            elif isinstance(item, list):
                parameters.extend(self._parameter(p) for p in item)
            elif isinstance(item, Merge):
                merges.append(item.nets)
            elif isinstance(item, InstanceStmt):
                instances.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, Placeholder) and item.index < len(self.blocks):
                properties[f"behavioral_block_{item.index}"] = self.blocks[item.index]

        port_names = module.port_names()
        ports = [
            Port(
                name=n,
                direction=DIR_MAP.get(directions.get(n, "inout"), PortDirection.INOUT),
                domain=domain_of(n),
                discipline=types.get(n, ""),
            )
            for n in port_names
        ]

        # ── nets: assign/alias merge nets; a module port names its merged net
        parent: dict[str, str] = {}

        def find(net: str) -> str:
            while parent.get(net, net) != net:
                net = parent[net]
            return net

        for group in merges:
            for other in group[1:]:
                a, b = find(group[0]), find(other)
                if a != b:
                    keep, drop = (
                        (b, a) if b in port_names and a not in port_names else (a, b)
                    )
                    parent[drop] = keep

        net_map: NetMap = {}
        for n in port_names:
            add_port_to_net(net_map, find(n), "", n)

        subcircuits: list[SubCircuit] = []
        for stmt in instances:
            target = modules.get(stmt.module)
            param_names = target.param_names() if target else []
            params = [
                Parameter(name=n, default_value=v, properties=props)
                for n, expr in stmt.named_params.items()
                for v, props in [parameter_value(expr)]
            ] + [
                Parameter(
                    name=param_names[i] if i < len(param_names) else f"p{i}",
                    default_value=v,
                    properties=props,
                )
                for i, expr in enumerate(stmt.ordered_params)
                for v, props in [parameter_value(expr)]
            ]
            for inst in stmt.instances:
                for port, net in self._connections(inst, stmt.module, target):
                    add_port_to_net(net_map, find(net), inst.name, port)
                subcircuits.append(
                    SubCircuit(
                        name=inst.name,
                        circuit_name=stmt.module,
                        parameters=params,
                    )
                )

        return Circuit(
            name=module.name,
            ports=ports,
            parameters=parameters,
            subcircuits=subcircuits,
            connections=net_map_to_connections(net_map),
            properties=properties,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _parameter(spec: ParamSpec) -> Parameter:
        value, props = parameter_value(spec.expr)
        if spec.local:
            props["localparam"] = "true"
        if spec.type:
            props["type"] = spec.type
        return Parameter(name=spec.name, default_value=value, properties=props)

    @staticmethod
    def _connections(
        inst: HierInst, module: str, target: ModuleData | None
    ) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        """``(instance port, net)`` pairs for one instance."""
        target_ports = target.port_names() if target else []
        conns: list[tuple[str, Any]] = list(inst.named.items())
        conns += [
            (target_ports[i] if i < len(target_ports) else f"p{i}", net)
            for i, net in enumerate(inst.ordered)
        ]
        if inst.wildcard:
            if target is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{inst.name}: `.*` needs the definition of module {module!r}"
                )
            conns += [(p, IMPLICIT) for p in target_ports if p not in inst.named]

        pairs = []
        for port, net in conns:
            if net is None:
                continue  # unconnected
            if net is IMPLICIT:
                net = port
            elif not isinstance(net, (NetRef, Literal)):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{inst.name}.{port}: unsupported port expression {net!r}"
                )
            pairs.append((port, str(net)))
        return pairs

def parameter_value(expr: str) -> tuple[ParameterValue | None, dict[str, str]]:
    """Numeric value when ``expr`` is a literal, else the expression text."""
    if is_si_number(expr):
        return parse_parameter_number(expr.replace("_", "")), {}
    m = SIZED_RE.fullmatch(expr)
    if m:
        value = int(m.group(2).replace("_", ""), BASES[m.group(1).lower()])
        return parse_parameter_number(str(value)), {}
    return None, {"expr": expr}

class SystemVerilogWriter:
    """Convert a Netlist model to structural SystemVerilog text."""

    def write(self, netlist: Netlist) -> str:
        lines: list[str] = []
        self.write_directives(netlist.directives, lines)
        lines.extend(
            v
            for k, v in netlist.properties.items()
            if k.startswith("behavioral_block_")
        )

        ext_by_name = {e.name: e for e in netlist.ext_circuits}
        circuit_by_name = {c.name: c for c in netlist.circuits}
        for circuit in netlist.circuits:
            if lines:
                lines.append("")
            self.write_module(circuit, ext_by_name, circuit_by_name, lines)
        lines.append("")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def write_directives(self, directives: list[Directive], lines: list[str]) -> None:
        for d in directives:
            if d.kind == DirectiveKind.INCLUDE:
                lines.append(f'`include "{d.value}"')
            elif d.kind == DirectiveKind.DEFINE:
                lines.append(f"`define {d.value}")
            elif d.kind == DirectiveKind.TIMESCALE:
                lines.append(f"`timescale {d.value}")

    def write_module(
        self,
        circuit: Circuit,
        ext_by_name: dict[str, ExternalCircuit],
        circuit_by_name: dict[str, Circuit],
        lines: list[str],
    ) -> None:
        header_params = [
            p for p in circuit.parameters if p.properties.get("localparam") != "true"
        ]
        params = ""
        if header_params:
            params = " #(" + ", ".join(self.param_decl(p) for p in header_params) + ")"
        ports = ",\n  ".join(
            " ".join(
                part
                for part in (
                    port.direction.name.lower(),
                    port.discipline,
                    sv_name(port.name),
                )
                if part
            )
            for port in circuit.ports
        )
        ports = f"(\n  {ports}\n)" if ports else "()"
        lines.append(f"module {sv_name(circuit.name)}{params} {ports};")

        for p in circuit.parameters:
            if p.properties.get("localparam") == "true":
                lines.append(f"  {self.param_decl(p, 'localparam')};")

        inst_nets = connections_to_instance_nets(circuit.connections)
        for ref in circuit.subcircuits:
            lines.append(
                self.write_instance(ref, inst_nets, ext_by_name, circuit_by_name)
            )

        lines.extend(
            f"  {v}"
            for k, v in circuit.properties.items()
            if k.startswith("behavioral_block_")
        )
        lines.append("endmodule")

    @staticmethod
    def param_decl(p: Parameter, keyword: str = "parameter") -> str:
        ptype = p.properties.get("type", "")
        type_str = f" {ptype}" if ptype else ""
        return f"{keyword}{type_str} {sv_name(p.name)} = {format_param_value(p)}"

    def write_instance(
        self,
        ref: SubCircuit,
        inst_nets: dict[tuple[str, str], str],
        ext_by_name: dict[str, ExternalCircuit],
        circuit_by_name: dict[str, Circuit],
    ) -> str:
        params = ""
        if ref.parameters:
            params = (
                " #("
                + ", ".join(
                    f".{sv_name(p.name)}({format_param_value(p)})"
                    for p in ref.parameters
                )
                + ")"
            )

        target = circuit_by_name.get(ref.circuit_name) or ext_by_name.get(
            ref.circuit_name
        )
        if target is not None:
            port_order = [p.name for p in target.ports]
        else:
            port_order = [pn for (inst, pn) in inst_nets if inst == ref.name]

        conns = ", ".join(
            f".{sv_name(pn)}({sv_name(inst_nets[(ref.name, pn)]) if (ref.name, pn) in inst_nets else ''})"
            for pn in port_order
        )
        return f"  {sv_name(ref.circuit_name)}{params} {sv_name(ref.name)} ({conns});"

def format_param_value(param: Parameter) -> str:
    """Plain number (SI suffixes are not SystemVerilog), else the expression text."""
    pval = param.default_value
    if pval is not None and pval.prefixed_value is not None:
        return f"{to_float(pval.prefixed_value):.12g}"
    return param.properties.get("expr", "0")

class VamsParser:
    """Parse Verilog-AMS netlist text into a Netlist model."""

    lark_instance: ClassVar[Lark | None] = None

    @classmethod
    def get_lark(cls) -> Lark:
        if cls.lark_instance is None:
            grammar_text = (
                resource_files("kfnetlist.morphnet.netlist.grammars")
                .joinpath("vams.lark")
                .read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            )
            cls.lark_instance = Lark(grammar_text, parser="lalr")
        return cls.lark_instance

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, text: str) -> Netlist:
        result = preprocess_vams(text)
        lark = cls.get_lark()
        tree = lark.parse(result.text)
        transformer = VamsTransformer(analog_blocks=result.analog_blocks)
        netlist = transformer.transform(tree)

        directives: list[Directive] = []
        for kind_str, value in result.directives:
            dk = DIRECTIVE_KIND_MAP.get(kind_str, DirectiveKind.UNSPECIFIED)
            if dk == DirectiveKind.INCLUDE:
                value = value.strip("\"'")
            directives.append(Directive(kind=dk, value=value))

        if directives:
            netlist = Netlist(
                name=netlist.name,
                top_circuit=netlist.top_circuit,
                circuits=netlist.circuits,
                ext_circuits=netlist.ext_circuits,
                properties=netlist.properties,
                directives=directives,
            )

        return netlist

def preprocess_vams(text: str) -> VamsPreprocessResult:
    """Prepare Verilog-AMS text for Lark parsing.

    1. Strip block comments and line comments.
    2. Extract backtick directives (`include, `define, `timescale, etc.).
    3. Replace analog blocks with __analog_placeholder__ N ; markers.
    """
    text = BLOCK_COMMENT_RE.sub("", text)
    text = LINE_COMMENT_RE.sub("", text)

    directives: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for m in DIRECTIVE_RE.finditer(text):
        directives.append((m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()))
    text = DIRECTIVE_RE.sub("", text)

    text, analog_blocks = replace_analog_blocks(text)

    text = re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n", text)
    text = text.strip()
    if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
        text += "\n"

    return VamsPreprocessResult(
        text=text,
        directives=directives,
        analog_blocks=analog_blocks,
    )
